title: Woman Stabs 2, Killing One, in Times Square and Is Shot Dead by N.Y.P.D.
summary: The police fired at the woman, who was holding two knives, after trying to use less lethal force, officials said. A woman, 32, was killed, and a man, 68, is in stable condition.
